notes: The session's web-search allowance ran out after the first few candidates, so most of this part was found by opening official, party, campaign and newspaper sites directly (their own site searches included), always with the kit's honest User-Agent.

Which candidates had already filed a campaign website was read with the project's own filed-websites step, run on a scratch copy of the database (the real database was only read). A filed address is listed here only where the site itself was opened and names the candidate and the office.

Sites that refused the kit's reader, so nothing was taken from them and nothing was worked around: the Minnesota Judicial Branch's site (403; no judge's page could be opened), mn.gov (a CAPTCHA page; not asked again), the City of Eagan's site (a bot check), voteramsay.com (403; not confirmed as anyone's campaign site), pineknotnews.com (403).

Nothing was found for Taylor Engelstad, John Larrive, Andy Dehmer, Brenda Carlson, Terry VanVeldhuizen, Damian Baum or Doug Clark beyond what they filed: no campaign website that could be confirmed, and no public office that a page states.

Verifier, 2026-10-02: every address in this file was opened again with the kit's honest User-Agent and all 37 answered. 66 findings checked: 61 kept, 5 removed (listed under 'removed'), 6 website descriptions reworded to what the pages show.
